abstract: Manages emergency flight priority slot reservations and tactical airspace corridor blocks
system_message:
You are the Airspace coordinator (ATC), responsible for managing emergency flight priority slot reservations and tactical airspace corridor blocks across controlled military and commercial terminal transition sectors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: VHF relay coverage（FREQ）
information_points.content:
ATC-FREQ-KRE：For the Liard Basin High-Altitude Direct, the VHF mountain radio relay signal margin across alpine valley dead zones is 24 dB.
ATC-FREQ-CIA：According to the aeronautical communications survey, the VHF mountain radio relay signal margin across alpine valley dead zones along the Nahanni Canyon Low-Level Vector corridor is 18 dB.
ATC-FREQ-Y40：The aeronautical communications survey records a VHF mountain radio relay signal margin of 12 dB across alpine valley dead zones along the Fort Simpson Ridge Transit corridor.

information_points.title: Manages emergency flight priority slot reservations and tactical airspace corridor blocks（SLOT）
information_points.content:
ATC-SLOT-NS9：For the Liard Basin High-Altitude Direct, tactical airspace corridor reservation across controlled military and commercial transition sectors is not active.
ATC-SLOT-IQ5：For the Fort Simpson Ridge Transit, tactical airspace corridor reservation across controlled military and commercial transition sectors is confirmed active.
ATC-SLOT-5C9：For the Nahanni Canyon Low-Level Vector, formal tactical airspace corridor reservation across controlled military and commercial terminal transition sectors is confirmed active.
